answer: Each agent registers on the ledge board with one ivory seal. An issuer may issue at most five seals per epoch, locking 30 per seal; the applicant locks 70 and pays a 10 fee. The sparrow log lists all seals, so anyone can count per issuer: a sixth seal is rejected, over-issue burns bonds. The k-th fake costs 70 at risk plus 10 sunk plus 30 issuer bond, and every fifth fake needs a new issuer key. For 1,000 fakes: 110,000 credits, no merging. A rented-issuer ring fails: the sparrow log exposes reuse and burns its bonds. An honest agent pays once, 70 returned after a clean epoch.
